evals.prompt: Our Patroni primary suddenly became a replica and the app can't write. Patroni log says `DCS is not accessible`. Consul is our DCS. What do we do? Should I just promote pg1 manually?
expectations: Says do not promote manually / check DCS quorum first
Checks Consul quorum with raft list-peers or equivalent
Explains demotion is by design to avoid split-brain
Mentions ACL/network as other causes of DCS inaccessibility

evals.prompt: Failover after a hard kill of the primary takes about 25 seconds. We want it faster. Can we set ttl to 5 and loop_wait to 5?
expectations: Explains ttl is the max time to detect a dead primary
Warns about false demotions/instability and says to rehearse in a lab
Distinguishes graceful stop (faster) from hard kill

evals.prompt: We switched Consul to default_policy=deny and now Patroni logs 403 from Consul. DNS for master.pg-lab.service.consul also returns nothing. What's missing?
expectations: Patroni token needs key_prefix service/ and session + service prefixes
DNS needs a default token with read on the agent
Notes tokens should be handed out before switching to deny
Does not paste a real secret value
